description: A corner ensuite with glass on two sides, smoked to the exact grade where the view survives and you disappear. A stone bath stands clear of the walls; the shower is a warm seam in the floor. Nothing in here has a handle you have to find.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
